files.caption: Two photographs of 2461 Wilbraham Road, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 2461 Wilbraham Road reads: One-half block from Germantown Rd. Five large, cool rooms and bath on first floor with stairs to large unfinished room on second floor. Full basement and gas fired furnace. Beautiful well-shaded lot with 2-car garage, chicken house, fruits and berries. property insulated and has aluminum siding. Asking $13,500.
